column1: # Folketingsvalgene den 7. Maj 1915 med Suppleringsvalg i Tiden 1913-15 (Statistiske Meddelelser, 4. Række, 48. Bind, 1. Hefte); general-election constituency tables pages 12-32 (Færøerne voted 12 May 1915), by-elections (Suppleringsvalg 1913-15) pages 33-34; a ditto mark (") on a ballot line is written as 0
# misprint: 13 Københavns Amt 6: the parish rows of Vælgernes Antal add to 4090, the printed Tilsammen is 3990 (100 less); kept as printed
# p15 Holbæk Amt 4: Samsø parishes voted at a second polling place, Onsbjerg
# p29 Vejle Amt 4: the party letter is printed "V" without its period
# p32 Færø Amt: printed as "Færø Amts Valgkreds" without a number; no polling place printed; the Faroes voted on 12 May 1915 (introduction, p. 5)
